name: SPRITEFACE-the-walks-facing-hung
old: facingDrawn = seen === null ? null : { yaw: seen, turn: turnYaw() ?? seen };
new: facingDrawn = seen === null ? null : { yaw: turnYaw() ?? seen, turn: turnYaw() ?? seen };
note: The bug Mac saw: the wings hung on the walk's facing - round before the picture on a key, sliding up to half a picture off it as the eye goes round.

name: SPRITEFACE-read-before-the-repaint
new: const seen = FP ? null : portrayedYaw(pending.length ? pending[pending.length - 1].orientation : shown.orientation,
note: The picture a repaint still in flight will show, not the one shown: the wings turn DELAYED_FRAMES before the sprite.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-saddles-facing-dropped
new: const seen = FP || last.riding ? null : portrayedYaw(
note: In the saddle no facing: a rider's wings fall back to the camera-turned body's yaw, off the horse's picture.

name: SPRITEFACE-first-person-faced
note: First person faced too - the billboard stands on the camera; with the eye on the feet it has no bearing, and with FP_HEAD's lift it reads one the picture does not show.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-sign-turned
old: const y = Math.atan2(toCamera[0], toCamera[2]) - orientation * ANGLE_PER_ORIENTATION * Math.PI / 180;
new: const y = Math.atan2(toCamera[0], toCamera[2]) + orientation * ANGLE_PER_ORIENTATION * Math.PI / 180;
note: The wheel run the wrong way - EOTB-IL's own finding: a figure turning left drawn turning right.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-step-not-the-pictures
old: const y = Math.atan2(toCamera[0], toCamera[2]) - orientation * ANGLE_PER_ORIENTATION * Math.PI / 180;
new: const y = Math.atan2(toCamera[0], toCamera[2]) - orientation * 40 * Math.PI / 180;
note: Forty degrees a picture, not the wheel's 45.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-bearing-not-the-eyes
note: The line of sight's bearing read off the wrong axes (x and z swapped).

name: SPRITEFACE-the-poses-facing-hung
old: f.yaw = eye ? portrayedYaw(view, [eye[0] - feet[0], 0, eye[2] - feet[2]]) : null;
note: A peer's wings hung on the pose's smooth facing, not the picture drawn of them.

name: SPRITEFACE-a-peers-line-reversed
old: f.yaw = eye ? portrayedYaw(view, [eye[0] - feet[0], 0, eye[2] - feet[2]]) : null;
new: f.yaw = eye ? portrayedYaw(view, [feet[0] - eye[0], 0, feet[2] - eye[2]]) : null;
note: The line of sight from the eye to the figure, not from the figure to the eye: every peer's wings faced about.

name: SPRITEFACE-faced-undrawn
old: faceOf: (id) => { const r = figs.get(id); return r?.batch && r.face && r.face.yaw !== null ? r.face : null; },
new: faceOf: (id) => { const r = figs.get(id); return r?.face ?? null; },
note: A facing with no line of sight (no eye) handed on - a null yaw the aura would turn to nothing.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-pose-not-the-picture
old: ? { feet: w.at, yaw: face ? face.yaw : w.yaw, turn: face ? face.turn : null, bones: fig ? auraSpriteBones(fig) : null }
new: ? { feet: w.at, yaw: w.yaw, turn: face ? face.turn : null, bones: fig ? auraSpriteBones(fig) : null }

name: SPRITEFACE-the-turning-not-kept
note: The body's turning dropped at the step: the swing reads the picture.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-swing-reads-the-picture
old: const yaw = Number.isFinite(w.turnYaw) ? w.turnYaw : Number.isFinite(w.yaw) ? w.yaw : 0, at = w.at;
new: const yaw = Number.isFinite(w.yaw) ? w.yaw : 0, at = w.at;
note: Every 45-degree change of the picture read as a turn: the cloak twists and the wing tips' trail slides and springs back.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-gather-off-the-figure
note: Mine gathered off the figure, which no longer carries a facing: the camera-turned body's yaw for every sprite.

name: SPRITEFACE-the-view-keeps-none
note: The view never keeps the facing the sprite drew in.

name: SPRITEFACE-a-peers-light-off-the-pose
note: A peer gathered on the pose's facing: the wings' light (auraWingLights, read off the gather) stands up to half a picture round the body from the wings.
